title: Cats and Creatures
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 26 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Cats, and then creatures. For two weeks at the end of August 2022 nearly every drawing was a cat: black, boxy, big-eared, standing or sitting in a striped room with its teeth showing. Then, in the first days of September, the cats gave way to flat single creatures, each one color on one color. Twenty-six works, August 20 to September 14.

The cats are built the way the masks were, from boxes, rings and grilles, but they have bodies now, and rooms to stand in. Stripes run behind them like wallpaper or a fence. Two of them share one drawing, and that drawing exists twice, minted 85 seconds apart, the second time with a signature.
Watch the stroke count fall. The cats are drawn in two to five hundred strokes. The flat creatures that follow them take thirty to fifty. The room ends on a scribbled horse that takes forty.

chapters.title: The First Cats
chapters.opening: August 20 to 24. Six cats in five days, from a crowned cat mask to a white cat on yellow.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #237
works.text: A black cat mask with a yellow crown sits on a dark red body, on a ground of gold scribbled with yellow bars. One eye is a blue ring with a cross in it, the other a yellow ring with a Z. The mouth is a box of white teeth under a yellow zigzag. It is the first work after the mask summer, drawn on August 20, 2022, and it is both things at once: the last mask and the first cat.
works.caption: A crowned black cat mask on a dark red body, one eye crossed and one marked with a Z.
works.reading: The crown is three yellow points drawn in loops. The eyes sit in rings of different colors, and the cross in the left one is red. Blue bars with yellow dashes run along the sides like fence posts. The body below the head is a cage of black and red lines. Recorded with 195 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #240
works.text: A black cat head with one red spiral eye and one blue, a grin of white teeth, and a crest of green, set in a weave of blue, yellow and black bars.
works.caption: A black cat head with one red spiral eye and one blue, grinning inside a weave of bars.
works.reading: The ears are two black triangles edged in red. The teeth sit in a red box with a yellow zigzag below. The bars around the head run in every direction, blue and yellow over black, and white rings float at the left. Recorded with 428 strokes, the most in the room's first week.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #242
works.text: A cat figure stands with one arm raised in a room of purple and blue stripes, two round yellow eyes with flowers in them, a box of teeth below.
works.caption: A cat figure with one arm raised stands in a room of purple and blue stripes, yellow flower eyes.
works.reading: The body is a box of red and orange line with a cage of teeth drawn in the chest. The raised arm is a red tube bent at the elbow. White lines run across the whole room like wires. Recorded with 268 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #243
works.text: A black cat with two glowing yellow eyes and a wide grille of white teeth fills the square, its ears tall, its chest a black block over a red rug. The eyes are drawn as yellow rings with light inside them, and the teeth are a long bar with black between each one. Stripes of yellow, pink and white stand behind the cat like a curtain. With 395 recorded strokes it is the densest of the first cats.
works.caption: A black cat with glowing yellow eyes and a long grille of teeth, tall ears, a striped curtain behind.
works.reading: The ears are drawn as two tall triangles with pink inside. The chest is a solid black block with a white bar across it like a collar. A magenta stripe runs down the right edge, and a dark table sits at the lower right. The yellow eyes are ringed in pink.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #244
works.caption: A blue cat with white ringed eyes and a red zigzag grin on a body of red and black bars.
works.reading: The face is drawn in white and black line over blue with yellow zigzag across the brow. The body is a tall box of bars in red, black and yellow. A red block of scribble sits at the lower right like a chair. Recorded with 262 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #245
works.caption: A tan cat face with four boxed eyes, a red nose and a grin of white teeth, on scored white.
works.reading: The four eyes are stacked two and two, each a box with a ring or a cross inside. The ears are two tall points drawn in black line. The ground is white with grey and black scratches like plaster. Recorded with 285 strokes.

chapters.title: Two Cats, Twice
chapters.opening: August 24 to 26. A seated cat in a red room, a white creature in a yellow one, a cat on cream, and a drawing of two cats that was minted twice.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #246
works.text: A black cat sits upright in a room of blue and red stripes, its face a white loop with a spiral eye, its body ruled with pink lines like a cage.
works.caption: A black cat sits upright in a room of blue and red stripes, its body ruled with pink lines.
works.reading: The cat's face is drawn as a white and yellow loop with a small grin, and its tail curls to the right. The stripes behind it are blue and red, with a red rail across the bottom. Recorded with 272 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #247
works.text: A white cat with a long neck and a red mouth sits in a yellow room, a small black cat at its feet and a bird on a perch at the upper left.
works.caption: A long-necked white cat with a red mouth in a yellow room, a tiny black cat at its feet.
works.reading: The white body is painted in soft strokes with grey shadow and a few lines for the ribs. The head has two round green eyes and a crest of spikes. The small black cat at the lower left is a tiny silhouette. Recorded with 340 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #248
works.text: A black cat stands on a cream ground with a red X over each eye, its ears tipped in pink, a grin of white teeth, and a pink collar around its neck. Its tail rises in a hook. The room behind it is pale: a few blocks of orange, blue and grey, and thin lines running in loops. It is the quietest cat in the room, and the first with the X in both eyes.
works.caption: A black cat stands on cream with a red X over each eye, pink-tipped ears, a pink collar.
works.reading: The body is drawn as a solid black shape with yellow and green line around it, and the legs are four straight bars. The collar is a loop of pink beads. Two spirals float in the room, one yellow at the left and one grey at the right. Recorded with 206 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #249
works.text: Two black cats side by side, the left one with a red X over one eye and a blue ring in the other, the right one with a red X and a green box. A small blue cat sits between them on a shelf. Below them a maze of black boxes with white line, and a yellow spiral at the right edge. The drawing was minted at 11:59 UTC on August 25, 2022, without a signature.
works.caption: Two black cats with red X eyes, a small blue cat between them, a maze of boxes below, unsigned.
works.reading: The left cat has a grin of white teeth in a red box and a blue ring with a yellow center for its right eye. The right cat's green box eye has a yellow ring in it. The small blue cat on the shelf has an X of its own. Yellow and blue bars frame the left and right edges. Recorded with 305 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #249
works.text: The same drawing, minted 85 seconds later, with one addition: the yellow signature at the lower right. Everything else is the same, the two cats, the small blue cat, the maze. Nine more strokes were recorded, and they are the signature. Both exist on the chain, and both hang here.
works.caption: Two black cats with red X eyes, a maze of boxes below, a yellow signature at the lower right.
works.reading: The signature sits at the lower right in yellow over the black of the maze. Nothing else in the image moved. Recorded with 314 strokes, nine more than the unsigned version, at 12:00 UTC on August 25, 2022.

artworkId.title: nnxyz nnotb #249
artworkId.visualNote: #249 two cats X eyes; unsigned first mint (ink 19826)

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #251
works.text: A cat-eared mask with two ringed eyes full of green and pink line, a cage of white teeth in a red mouth, and yellow beads along the right edge, on pale blue.
works.caption: A cat-eared mask with ringed eyes full of green and pink line, white teeth in a red cage.
works.reading: The ears are two orange triangles. The eyes are large rings filled with scribble, each with a green pupil. The teeth are white bars in a red box at the lower center. Recorded with 341 strokes.

chapters.title: Last Cats
chapters.opening: August 26 to 28. Two cats drawn in white, a dense scene with a bird, a scribbled cat on cream, and a cat robot in the dark.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #252
works.text: A white cat on black, its face a mass of pink, blue and yellow line, with a red X over one eye and a wide open eye on the other side, a blue beam coming in from the left, and a wide grin of white teeth. The ears are tall and striped. Blue and pink beads run down both sides. With 437 recorded strokes it is the most worked drawing in the room.
works.caption: A white cat on black, a red X over one eye, a blue beam from the left, a wide grin.
works.reading: The beam is a broad blue stroke with yellow zigzag inside it, and it ends at the crossed eye. The open eye is a black oval with a white highlight in a yellow ring. The grin is two rows of white teeth in a red mouth. A crown of yellow spikes sits between the ears.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #253
works.caption: A white cat head with one eye closed and one open, red ears, three black whiskers.
works.reading: The closed eye is a curve with lashes, the open one a ring with a spiral. The head sits on a striped neck of green and yellow. The whiskers are three black lines at the left. Recorded with 208 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #254
works.text: A dense scene with a yellow bird on a perch, a rocket, a creature in a green net, a figure with spiky hair at the lower left and a pink face at the right, on black with white crosses.
works.caption: A dense scene: a yellow bird, a rocket, a creature in a green net, a spiky figure, a pink face.
works.reading: The bird at the upper right has a long beak and a crest of green strokes. The rocket is a blue tube with a flame at its base. The net is a green grid over a dark shape. The white crosses on the black are stars. Recorded with 496 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #255
works.caption: A black cat sits on cream under yellow and white scribble, two blue spiral eyes and a blue grin.
works.reading: The cat is a solid black shape covered in loose yellow and white loops, and its features are drawn in blue: two spirals in boxes and a row of teeth. The tail curls to the right. Ninety-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #256
works.text: A black cat robot with a green box eye and a red box eye, a grille of white teeth, and a yellow zigzag running down its side, in the dark.
works.caption: A black cat robot with one green box eye and one red, a grille of white teeth, in the dark.
works.reading: The ears are drawn as two boxes with yellow spikes on top. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth, the largest marks in the picture. The body is a column of bars in white, green and red. Recorded with 199 strokes.

chapters.title: Flat Creatures
chapters.opening: August 28 to September 2. The drawings empty out. A white coat and a black figure on purple, a brown figure on maroon, and then single creatures in one color on one color.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #257
works.text: Two figures on purple: a white coat with a red cap, drawn in a few black lines, and a small black figure with a cloud of curly hair and a yellow eye. Eighty-two recorded strokes. Two days after the white cat on black, with its hundreds of lines, the drawing has emptied out to two shapes and a flat ground.
works.caption: A white coat with a red cap and a small black figure with curly hair stand on purple.
works.reading: The white coat is painted in soft strokes with a few black lines for the folds and the hand. The red cap has a yellow mark on it. The black figure's hair is a scribble of black and red loops, and its body is a flat silhouette with red at the chest.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #258
works.caption: A brown figure with two bars of zigzag across its eyes and waist stands on maroon.
works.reading: The figure is painted in brown with a red edge, and its arms curve out to the right. The two bars are blue with white zigzag inside, one across the eyes and one across the waist. Eighty-four strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #261
works.text: Two creatures with crowns and red ringed eyes lean on each other on a floor of yellow stripes, in a room of blue stripes, drawn in white, pink and black line.
works.caption: Two crowned creatures with red ringed eyes lean on each other on a floor of yellow stripes.
works.reading: The creature on the left is blue with a triangle head, the one on the right pink with a round head and a grin. Both have pink crowns. The floor is yellow with black stripes drawn in perspective, and a shadow falls to the right. Recorded with 256 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #263
works.text: A dark red figure dances on yellow, one leg raised, its head a long oval with a few yellow stitches, drawn in thirty-one strokes.
works.caption: A dark red figure dances on yellow, one leg raised, its long head stitched with yellow.
works.reading: The figure is one flat red shape with thin red lines for the joints. The arms are bent, one up and one down, and two twigs stand up from the shoulder like antlers. Thirty-one strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #264
works.text: A blue creature with a crest of zigzag and a yellow spiral eye walks on dark red, one arm held out, its body striped with the ground color.
works.caption: A blue creature with a zigzag crest and a yellow spiral eye walks on dark red, one arm held out.
works.reading: The stripes on the body are gaps where the red shows through the blue. The crest is a row of blue and yellow zigzag on the head. The hand at the left has three fingers. Fifty-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #265
works.text: A pink creature with a crocodile snout, a target eye and a crest of spikes stands on black with one leg raised, its fur drawn in pink zigzag.
works.caption: A pink creature with a crocodile snout and a target eye stands on black, one leg raised.
works.reading: The snout is a long pink shape with a row of white teeth, and the eye is a white target with an X in it. The crest is a line of pink spikes along the back of the head. Thirty strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #266
works.text: A teal creature drawn in line only, with a crest of zigzag, a red target eye and red teeth, standing on dark grey with its arms hanging.
works.caption: A teal line creature with a zigzag crest, a red target eye and red teeth stands on dark grey.
works.reading: Nothing is filled in. The body is a single teal outline with a few inner lines for the arms and the belt. The red eye and the red teeth are the only other color. Thirty-five strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #268
works.text: A black skull in profile on lavender, with an X for an eye and a few purple lines for the jaw and the teeth, ringed with short black wavy lines. A black oval lies below it like a shadow. It is the flat silhouette from the spring, back for one drawing, and the X that sat on the cats' eyes is now the only mark on the face.
works.caption: A black skull in profile on lavender, an X for an eye, ringed with short black wavy lines.
works.reading: The skull is one solid black shape with two small bumps at the back. The jaw is drawn in thin purple line with a few teeth. The wavy lines stand out from the top of the skull and the left side. Forty-eight strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #284
works.text: Twelve days later, a horse drawn in yellow, orange and white scribble over a black body, walking on teal with its head down and a mane of white lines.
works.caption: A horse in yellow, orange and white scribble over black walks on teal with its head down.
works.reading: The body is a black shape covered in loose yellow and orange loops, and the legs are drawn in thin black line with white loops at the hooves. The head hangs low with a white fringe for the mane. Pale blue patches at the feet are the ground. Forty strokes.

closing: Look again at the first cat, crowned and packed to the edges of the square, and then at the skull in profile, one black shape on lavender. The room moved from hundreds of strokes to a few dozen in two weeks. The X stayed in the eye the whole way.
